design_archetype.name: ARCHETYPE 5: LUXURY & EDITORIAL HAUTE COIFFURE
design_archetype.description: A high-fashion, cinematic aesthetic blending obsidian dark surfaces, warm muted gold accents, rich textured noise overlays, and architectural serif typography. Designed to deliver an Awwwards-level SOTD experience.

rules: Headings MUST use Cormorant Garamond with tight tracking (`tracking-tight` or `tracking-tighter`).
Subheadings & accents MUST use Syne with wide uppercase tracking (`tracking-[0.25em] text-xs uppercase`).
Body text MUST use Inter or Satoshi with comfortable line height (`leading-relaxed text-neutral-300`).
DO NOT exceed max text size of `text-5xl lg:text-6xl` for main hero title.
Hero subtitle gap rule: Jump between hero title and subtitle must not exceed 2 Tailwind steps.

visual_enhancers.tracing_beam: relative before:absolute before:inset-0 before:border before:border-transparent before:bg-[linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#C5A059,transparent)] before:opacity-0 hover:before:opacity-100 transition-all duration-500

layouts_and_sections.description: Sticky dark crystal navbar with blur background, #ONE SALON metallic logo, quick section links, Google rating chip (4.8 ★), and instant CTA 'Book Appointment'.

Dramatic full-height hero section with masked line-by-line reveal animation, high-resolution portrait video/image overlay, location pill ('Basavanagudi, Bengaluru'), 4.8★ Google Review badge, and primary booking CTA.
Ultra-slow drifting gold ribbon displaying high-end signature offerings with subtle diamond bullet separators.
Numbered editorial chapters (01, 02, 03) detailing #ONE SALON's philosophy, precision craftsmanship, and Basavanagudi heritage.
Bento-style category grid for Hair Cuts, Master Colouring, Regenerative Spa & Massages, and Luxury Shaves. Includes filter tabs, prices in INR, estimated durations, and stylist tags (Raju / Asif).
High-impact spotlight profiles for Raju (Master Colourist) and Asif (Senior Hair Sculptor) with their signature techniques, experience, and direct booking links.
Asymmetric editorial gallery showcasing cuts, colouring transformations, head spa rituals, and salon interior elegance.
Interactive reviews widget showcasing actual Google reviews (4.8 rating across 1,612 reviews) with client quotes, star breakdown, and Google verification badge.

Luxury multi-step appointment request form collecting client details (Name, Phone, Service, Preferred Stylist, Date, Time, Special Notes). Features live booking summary preview, instant confirmation modal, and direct WhatsApp / Call buttons.
Comprehensive contact panel with interactive address map card, operating hours, direct phone quick-call, and directions button.
Grand scale editorial footer featuring oversized #ONE SALON typography, quick links, address, operating hours, copyright, and smooth top scroll trigger.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a cohesive single-page luxury web app in React JS matching the Archetype 5 aesthetic for #ONE SALON.
Implement Lenis smooth scrolling or Framer Motion scroll-linked reveals for high-end feel.
Include kinetic title reveal animation in the hero section.
Ensure ALL interactive elements feature appropriate data-testid attributes.
Use Shadcn UI primitives for forms, select dropdowns, modals, and tabs.
Ensure contrast ratios are high (gold accent text on dark background strictly #C5A059, main body text #F9F8F6 or #A19B91).
Integrate the booking form with clear interactive feedback (toast notification via Sonner and a confirmation receipt dialog).
Feature real details: Google Rating 4.8 / 1612 reviews, Address in Basavanagudi, Phone +91 80 2950 2349, Stylists Raju & Asif.
